## Understanding the problem
A patient recovered if they have a Positive test followed by a Negative test on a later date. Recovery time = first negative test after the (first) positive minus the first positive date. Inconclusive tests are ignored; negatives before any positive don't count. Bob's inconclusive test on 02-05 is skipped, giving 02-12 − 02-01 = 11 days; Carol's early negative is ignored, giving 10 days.

Constraints suggest a straightforward self-join with aggregation.
k: Join positives to strictly later negatives, then aggregate MIN dates per patient.
MIN(negative date) over pairs where negative > positive automatically yields the first negative after the first positive.

a.n: Approach 1: Self-join on patient with date inequality
a.i: Pair each Positive row of a patient with Negative rows of the same patient occurring later. Grouping by patient, MIN(positive date) is the first positive and MIN(negative date) among valid pairs is the first subsequent negative; DATEDIFF gives recovery time. Patients with no valid pair vanish via the inner join.
s: Join covid_tests pos (result='Positive') with covid_tests neg (result='Negative', later date) on patient_id.
Group by patient; recovery_time = DATEDIFF(MIN(neg.test_date), MIN(pos.test_date)).

c.python:
-- MySQL solution (problem is SQL-only)
SELECT p.patient_id, p.patient_name, p.age,
       DATEDIFF(MIN(neg.test_date), MIN(pos.test_date)) AS recovery_time
FROM patients p
JOIN covid_tests pos ON pos.patient_id = p.patient_id AND pos.result = 'Positive'
JOIN covid_tests neg ON neg.patient_id = p.patient_id AND neg.result = 'Negative'
                     AND neg.test_date > pos.test_date
GROUP BY p.patient_id, p.patient_name, p.age
ORDER BY recovery_time ASC, p.patient_name ASC;

a.t: O(T²) worst-case join pairs, typically near-linear with indexes on (patient_id, result, test_date).

w: An alternative uses window functions (MIN positive per patient, then MIN negative after it). Pitfalls: using >= instead of > on dates, counting negatives that precede the first positive, and forgetting that Inconclusive rows simply never match the join. Follow-up: report recovery per infection episode (positive → negative cycles).
